_comment: dataRoot = the original game's data folder (contains Scripts/, BlockDB2.BDB, ...). Use forward slashes. A diggles_config.json next to the executable (or in the project root in the editor) overrides this file. locale: leave empty to detect the text language from the data, or force e.g. "ru". baseLightMin (0..1) and classLightCap (0..4) are lighting tuning knobs; the DigglesTuning component can save them here. remoteConsolePort: loopback TCP port of the developer console (0 disables).
